    • provider

      public JceDataKeyProvider.Builder provider(Provider provider)
      Sets the Provider used to look up the AESWrap Cipher for wrapping and unwrapping data keys, so a FIPS-validated or otherwise pinned provider can be selected per provider instance instead of being installed as the JVM's globally highest-priority provider.

      Resolved once at build() time: if the provider cannot supply the transform, build() throws IllegalStateException immediately rather than letting the misconfiguration surface later as a DecryptionException on the first unwrap.

      Parameters:
      provider - the Provider to use; defaults to the JDK's default provider lookup
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build
